No engine, backend or simulation source change; lockfile pin moves forward.

Stage 2 slice 07b finite IO: bounded shared IO service owner, page/WAL work composed on shared storage, finite IO acceptance pinned; rebased onto the dependency security patch. Model 2 remains inactive; no timing promotion.

Isolated serial server verification for browser scored/shared runs; bounded execute/replay protocol and exact event-prefix replay; preserve main finite IO and dependency security patch; Model 2 inactive

Reviewed optional V3 recorded-key cache through compute and policy roles; preserve V2 finite IO, isolation and eight replay hashes; combined cache IO explicitly refused; retained main isolation descriptor reconstructs exactly with its frozen syntax and eight entrypoints; no activation or timing promotion

Finite non-cache app and directed link faults with bounded read retries on merged cache and isolation baseline; 88 historical host files, eight composition hashes and compiler/bounds/cache/finite IO outcomes preserved; cache V3 fault/retry refusal retained; 52 targeted tests passed; no activation or timing promotion

Owned immutable browser submissions on the merged cache and fault baseline; exact token/daemon cleanup review; declared-host-boundary/1 frozen reconstruction reads retained host declarations so future host additions stay reconstructable; strictly additive submission storage

Integration-test isolation only: the first-stack submission integration test now creates and migrates its own disposable database, and the lesson upgrade check applies later additive migrations before the full release guard set; no engine, backend runtime or migration change

Stage 2 slice 12 report data: bounded first-stack report evidence captured with durable cuts, RunRecord projection and verification status, reviewed contracts and evidence labels; rebased onto the integration-test isolation fix. No UI; Model 2 inactive.

Release operations only: preflight fetches missing third-party dependency images (for example Redis) before any service stops, so a fresh host can start with --pull never; existing hosts keep their cached images. Runbook notes for new-host first release and the ECDSA host fingerprint. No engine or application runtime change.

Release operations fix: dependency image preparation is limited to the started services and their transitive depends_on closure (for example Redis), so locally built fixture services are never pulled; existing hosts keep cached images. Unit-tested closure. No engine or application runtime change.

Server-owned scored challenges: versioned lose-an-app-server/1 definition with server-only hidden workloads and rubric, serial hidden execution after visible-cut verification, immutable score audit, allowlisted client score summary, browser boundary forbids the scoring directory. Model 2 inactive.

Stage 2 slice 13: conditional supported compute subtotal computed on the server at report assembly from verified allocation usage and frozen server tariffs (Unknown otherwise, full cost Unknown); one shared simulation captureReport used by server and browser; durable cuts carry measured usage only. Model 2 inactive.

Stage 2 slice 16: version-dispatched historical reads (Model 1 V1/V2, internal Model 2, first-stack incl. reports/verification/scores), bounded owned historical prefix replay under the exact recorded lock, explicit Model 1 retirement availability (still off), typed migrated-from lineage; additive migration; merged with slice 13 server-side cost.

Historical reads: a stored record without a version string keeps the original v1 validation and refusal message (restoring the 'missing, corrupt or incompatible' report state); only an explicit unknown version is refused as unsupported. No new imports or capabilities.

Account essentials (default-off) rebased onto slice 16: SES/Resend mail adapter, Better Auth verification and password reset with uniform anti-enumeration responses, verification ledger registered after signup commits (no detached transaction), HMAC-keyed Redis quotas, Turnstile verification, re-authenticated pseudonymising deletion, owner-scoped export; additive migration renamed to 20261023000000_account_essentials after historical replay; release guards merged.

R1 scored scenario library: six server-owned scenario definitions (URL redirect, catalogue, reviews, small paste, preloaded news, price history) with visible samples, hidden workloads and outcome rubrics on the merged engine; review entries added for each definition. Model 2 inactive.

Security fix W35-02: account export of scored results omits the server-only score audit (rubric, hidden workload inputs, evidence, receipts) and carries only the verified public score summary; regression test proves no hidden marker can appear in an export.

Identity simplification (w34): independent append-only history anchor, authenticated gzip archives for frozen proofs, immutable slice attestations and verified historical memoization; no production descriptor, capability, import, loading or verification semantics changed.

Security fixes W35-01 and W35-04: one shared Model 1 admission with per-owner, global, queued and active reservations held by durable deployment rows; finite freeform and lifetime bounds enforced in the worker; readiness deep checks run at startup and on a bounded background interval and are served as a cached snapshot, with an nginx limit on the public health route.

Readiness reports dependency loss immediately: Redis connection close and database pool errors invalidate the cached readiness snapshot without starting extra deep probes; a probe that began before the loss cannot restore success. Fixes the packaging rehearsal expectation that health fails at once when Redis stops.
Supply-chain pins (W35-05): the backend base image oven/bun:1.3.14 and production Redis are pinned to reviewed multi-platform index digests; same tags, no application source change.

Dependency security patch: zod 4.4.3/4.6.5 -> 4.6.6 (GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5, high), body-parser 2.3.0 -> 2.4.0 (GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828, high DoS), fast-uri 3.1.8 -> 3.1.9 (four advisories). Pinned through root overrides; no application source change.

Readiness transfer fix: deep schema and migration-history verification (about 54 KB per run) runs at startup and after a failure or lost database session instead of every 10 seconds in each process; scheduled probes are SELECT 1 plus a Redis ping. Fixes the hosted database transfer quota exhaustion.

Self-hosted PostgreSQL option with review fixes: private Compose postgres kept intact until release shutdown is verified, TCP readiness after first init, backups wait for recovery after reboot, isolated rehearsal role, and a configuration-only provider switch at the accepted SHA without rebuilding. Provider-neutral URL policy: plaintext only to the exact local service; remote needs sslmode=verify-full.

Scored challenge hidden workloads and rubrics move to a private server-only store verified by public sha256 commitments; old exposed suites become public practice workloads; fail-closed loading; no engine physics change.

Prepare default-closed first-stack verifier: session ownership before recovery, bounded dependencies, exact protected EC2 qualification, safe expiring availability, admission and execution fences, scored drain on service stop, release lock exclusion and a reviewed systemd/rootless host template. No engine physics, public routes, UI, sharing or activation.

Release hygiene: free-space preflight before builds, pruning of old backend images only after acceptance (keeps accepted, rollback and in-use images; never volumes or other images), and a private redacted diagnostics file for failed Compose commands.

Daily PostgreSQL backups to Cloudflare R2 (S3-compatible) with 28-day retention that never deletes outside the backup prefixes or newer objects, alerts that never fail silently, and an R2 restore path; AWS-specific stack kept optional.

Email verification, password reset and signup captcha behind configuration (default off), reviewed by astra (review-w45, review-w45-fixes): Resend/SES adapters with durable mail intents, hashed single-use reset credentials, mailbox proof before username selection, generic non-enumerating responses, server-side Turnstile verification, fail-closed production configuration.

Release accepts the two strictly additive mail-table migrations (CREATE TABLE and indexes only) on populated databases; regression test requires every post-baseline migration to be reviewed as additive.
Mail-table foreign keys gain ON UPDATE CASCADE to match the Prisma relation default; new schema-drift integration test runs the release's prisma migrate diff check
